name: date-input
title: Date Input
description: A date input field that looks like a standard input but opens a calendar datepicker popover on click. Uses namespace exports: DateInput.Root.

docs.lead: A date input field that visually matches the Input component but opens a calendar popover for date selection.
docs.usage:
import * as DateInput from "@/components/ui/date-input"

<DateInput.Root value={date} onChange={setDate} placeholder="Select a date" />

examples.description: Basic date input with default placeholder.

examples.title: With Placeholder
examples.description: Date input with a custom placeholder.
examples.code: <DateInput.Root value={date} onChange={setDate} placeholder="Pick a start date" />

examples.description: Date input with a custom date format string (date-fns).
